summary: Star Citizen entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Star Citizen
entries.definitive_edition: No final definitive edition; current live alpha client with exact patch/server/account state documented

emulation.notes: Use official RSI PC launcher only.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official Windows PC live alpha build

primary.version: Current Star Citizen live alpha client
primary.why: Star Citizen is an active-development PC-only alpha/live-service archive target. The current live client is the only meaningful primary route, and the archive must record the exact patch, server, wipe/persistence state, pledge/account state, and whether PTU content was used.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current RSI launcher live build. Record exact launcher version, LIVE/PTU channel, date, region, shard/server, account/pledge state, purchased versus in-game ships, reputation, aUEC/wipe state, graphics settings, controls, party state, and major bugs encountered.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting a dated test build separately.
secondary.why: PTU state is not the stable live archive target.

secondary.what_to_play: Do not merge into this entry; add as a separate game if/when released.
secondary.why: It is not the same playable product as Star Citizen's persistent universe.

entries.remaster_caveats: Recheck before every archive run. Treat PTU/Evocati, Squadron 42, and old alpha builds as separate dated artifacts.
